name: List All Units
description: Returns all units that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[Id]
queryFilters.description: Filter by unique identifier of the unit

queryFilters.name: filters[PropertyId]
queryFilters.description: Filter by unique identifier of the property associated with the unit

queryFilters.name: filters[UnitGroupId]
queryFilters.description: Filter by unique identifier of the unit group the unit is a part of

queryFilters.name: filters[LeasingType]
queryFilters.description: Filter results based on a single leasing type value. Enum: "ConventionalUnit" "BedUnit"

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter units last updated at or after this date-time. All GET requests must include a filter for [Id] (if available) or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

responseFields.name: data
responseFields.description: Array of unit objects

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the unit

responseFields.name: data[].Name
responseFields.description: The unit name as displayed in the AppFolio Property Manager

responseFields.name: data[].Bathrooms
responseFields.description: The number of desired bathrooms

responseFields.name: data[].Bedrooms
responseFields.description: The number of desired bedrooms

responseFields.name: data[].CustomFields
responseFields.description: The custom fields for the associated entity

responseFields.name: data[].SquareFeet
responseFields.description: The size of the unit in square feet

responseFields.name: data[].ListedMarketRent
responseFields.description: The rent per month as listed on the market

responseFields.name: data[].ListedRent
responseFields.description: The rent per month as listed on the market. This value reflects either the market rent plus amenities fees or the advertised rent, depending on whether "Use Market Rent On Ads" is enabled in AppFolio Property Manager.

responseFields.name: data[].MarketRent
responseFields.description: The unit's base market rent, representing its estimated fair market value based on current market conditions and comparable properties. This value may differ from ListedRent, as it does not include advertised adjustments or amenity fees.

responseFields.name: data[].Status
responseFields.description: The status of the unit. Enum: "Occupied" "Vacant" "Vacant Rented" "Notice" "Notice Rented"

responseFields.name: data[].PropertyId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the property associated with the unit

responseFields.name: data[].CurrentOccupancyId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the current occupant of the unit

responseFields.name: data[].UnitGroupId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the unit group the unit is a part of

responseFields.name: data[].LeasingType
responseFields.description: The type of lease for the unit. Enum: "ConventionalUnit" "BedUnit"

responseFields.name: data[].Description
responseFields.description: A brief, informative description of the unit

responseFields.name: data[].Address1
responseFields.description: The primary street address of the unit

responseFields.name: data[].Address2
responseFields.description: Additional street address information pertaining to the unit

responseFields.name: data[].City
responseFields.description: The city where the unit is located

responseFields.name: data[].State
responseFields.description: The state where the unit is located

responseFields.name: data[].Zip
responseFields.description: The zip code where the unit is located

responseFields.name: data[].MaintenanceNotes
responseFields.description: A brief informative message about the unit's maintenance

responseFields.name: data[].MarketingTitle
responseFields.description: The title of the listing for syndication

responseFields.name: data[].MarketingDescription
responseFields.description: A description of the listing for syndication

responseFields.name: data[].NonRevenue
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not the unit is rentable and is a model unit, office or other non revenue unit

responseFields.name: data[].ApplicationURL
responseFields.description: The URL link(s) to the application page of the unit(s) accepting online applications

responseFields.name: data[].AppliancesIncluded
responseFields.description: User-defined appliances that are included with the unit

responseFields.name: data[].AcceptingApplications
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not the unit is accepting applications

responseFields.name: data[].PostedToInternet
responseFields.description: Indicates whether the unit has been posted to a third-party listings page.

responseFields.name: data[].PostedToWebsite
responseFields.description: Indicates whether a vacant unit was posted to the AppFolio listings page.

responseFields.name: data[].YouTubeURL
responseFields.description: The URL of the YouTube video for the listing(s)

responseFields.name: data[].Link
responseFields.description: A link to the unit page in the AppFolio Property Manager

responseFields.name: data[].Deposit
responseFields.description: The security deposit amount

responseFields.name: data[].CatsAllowed
responseFields.description: The unit's cat policy. Enum: "Yes" "No" or null

responseFields.name: data[].DogsAllowed
responseFields.description: The unit's dog policy. Enum: "Large & Small" "Small Only" "No" or null

responseFields.name: data[].Tags
responseFields.description: User-defined tag(s) that categorize the unit

responseFields.name: data[].UnitType
responseFields.description: The floor plan of the unit

responseFields.name: data[].UnitTypeId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the floor plan associated with the unit

responseFields.name: data[].UtilitiesIncluded
responseFields.description: User-defined utilities that are included with the unit

responseFields.name: data[].CreatedAt
responseFields.description: When the unit was created in the AppFolio Property Manager

responseFields.name: data[].RentStatus
responseFields.description: Status / type of rent control. Enum: null "RentControlled" "RentStabilized" "Decontrolled"

responseFields.name: data[].ApplicationFee
responseFields.description: The application fee amount

responseFields.name: data[].Amenities
responseFields.description: Array containing a unit's amenities

responseFields.name: data[].HvacFilters
responseFields.description: Array containing a unit's HVAC filters

responseFields.name: data[].HvacDetail
responseFields.description: The HVAC details of the unit

responseFields.name: data[].RentReady
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not the unit is ready to be occupied by a tenant

responseFields.name: data[].AvailableOn
responseFields.description: The date upon which the unit can be leased

responseFields.name: data[].LastInspectedDate
responseFields.description: The date the unit was last inspected

responseFields.name: data[].ReadyForShowingOn
responseFields.description: The date upon which the unit is ready for showing

responseFields.name: data[].HiddenAt
responseFields.description: When the property was marked inactive state by an AppFolio Property Manager user

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The date the unit's details were last updated

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
